reserves.howRate: Monthly rate: the amount divided by the months until it repeats. A yearly bill of €1,200 is always €100 a month, however close the due date.
reserves.howTarget: Target: the bill amount minus the monthly rates still to come before it is due. In the month it is due this is the full amount, right after it 0.
reserves.howPot: Pot: the balance you set, plus all planned transfers to the reserve account since then, minus all infrequent bills due since then. Transfers out of the reserve account are not counted, because they usually move the money for one of these bills. If the pot differs from your real balance, correct it.
reserves.dialogDescription: The balance applies from today. After that the app adds planned transfers to this account and takes out infrequent bills when they are due.
